summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Perpetual Subordinated Indenture dated September 14, 2026 with The Bank of New York Mellon as trustee, plus a form of Fixed Rate Resetting Perpetual Subordinated Security and related legal opinions and consents, and incorporated the exhibits into its existing Form F-3 shelf registration. This is an ordinary debt-capital issuance under an existing shelf and does not constitute a special situation. No price, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed, and the securities carry interest-cancellation and subordination mechanics. Watch for any subsequent pricing supplement disclosing coupon and size.
